homePage.introTitle:
Your Business Advisory Firm
Personal. Competent.
Future-oriented.

paragraphs.text: We are a modern business advisory firm with two locations, providing comprehensive tax and business consulting services from a single source. Our focus is on the individual support of small and medium-sized enterprises as well as private clients. We combine professional expertise with personal proximity and clear communication.

paragraphs.title: Advisory with Perspective and Personal Attention
paragraphs.text: As a firm of manageable size, we place great value on a trusting and long-term partnership. We advise you on tax, business, and organizational matters – from business start-ups and ongoing consulting to optimization and succession planning.Your personal advisor understands your situation, thinks ahead, and works with you to develop tailored solutions.

paragraphs.title: Digital Solutions That Simplify
paragraphs.text: We rely on modern, digital workflows to make your day-to-day business easier. Secure online portals allow documents to be exchanged, archived, and accessed at any time. This gives you transparency over your figures and more time to focus on your core business.

paragraphs.title: Expertise That Stays Up to Date
paragraphs.text: We ensure a high standard of advisory quality through continuous professional training and development. As tax law and business conditions change constantly, we stay up to date and apply this knowledge specifically for your benefit.

paragraphs.title: Our Commitment
paragraphs.text: We stand for quality, reliability, and advisory services at eye level. Our goal is to be a dependable partner for you – professionally and personally, today and in the future.

paragraphs.title: Our Mission
paragraphs.text: We use digital tools and sound expertise to provide our clients with clear, practical, and understandable solutions. We think ahead and support you in making well-informed decisions.

paragraphs.title: Our Vision
paragraphs.text: We aim to be perceived as a modern, personal business advisory firm that supports its clients over the long term and successfully guides them through tax, economic, and digital change.

paragraphs.title: Our Locations
paragraphs.text: We are available to you at two locations: Düsseldorf and Berlin

businessConsulting.title: Business Start-Up Consulting
businessConsulting.subtitle: Our Support for Your Start-Up

texts.text: Starting your own business offers many opportunities, but also raises numerous questions. Decisions regarding legal form, financing, pricing, and organization have a long-term impact on your success. As there is rarely only one “right” solution, careful planning tailored to your personal situation and goals is essential.

A good business idea and entrepreneurial spirit are important foundations. Equally important, however, is thorough preparation. Those who plan early and seek professional advice avoid costly mistakes and create a solid basis for a successful start.

texts.title: Your Benefit
texts.text: Professional start-up consulting is an investment that pays off both strategically and financially. We help you make sound decisions, minimize risks, and build your business on a solid foundation from the very beginning.

content: Preparation of business plans, profitability, and liquidity calculations
Financial planning and support in bank and funding discussions
Advice on grants and public funding programs
Clarification of VAT-related matters
Introduction and setup of financial accounting
Support with pricing, costing, and office organization
Advice on personnel planning
Preparation of start-up assessments
Evaluation of market and success prospects
Selection of the most suitable legal form from a tax and business perspective

financialAccounting.title: Financial Accounting
financialAccounting.subtitle: Our Financial Accounting Services

texts.text: We take care of your financial accounting so that you can fully concentrate on your daily business. Proper and meaningful accounting forms the basis for sound business decisions. It is therefore essential that all business transactions are recorded correctly, accurately, and transparently.

We advise you comprehensively on all accounting-related matters and support you in establishing a clearly structured and transparent accounting system – whether you handle your accounting in-house or outsource it entirely to us.

texts.title: Digital, Efficient, and Insightful
texts.text: Our work is based on modern digital software solutions that ensure secure and efficient data processing, always in compliance with legal requirements for digital bookkeeping.

Regular management reports provide meaningful key figures and transparency regarding your company’s economic development. Deviations can be identified early and corrective measures taken in good time.

content: Setup and ongoing management of financial accounting, including fixed assets accounting
Industry-specific accounting solutions, e.g. for trades, car dealerships, and medical professions
Cost center and cost type analyses
Monthly management reports and individual business analyses
Preparation and timely submission of VAT advance returns and recapitulative statements

financialStatements.title: Financial Statements and Tax Returns
financialStatements.subtitle: Our Services in Financial Statements and Tax Returns

texts.text: Why deal with complex and time-consuming obligations when you can focus on your core business? Preparing annual financial statements and tax returns requires not only expertise, but also secure handling of powerful IT systems, coordinated workflows, and multiple control steps.

We take care of these tasks for you – reliably, structured, and on time. The result is a professionally prepared set of annual financial statements along with the corresponding tax returns. During a personal annual review meeting, we explain the results clearly and provide you with well-presented documentation. This forms a solid basis for discussions with banks, authorities, and other business partners.

texts.title: Security and Relief
texts.text: To ensure that you can focus on what matters most and feel secure in tax and legal matters, we prepare annual financial statements in accordance with commercial and tax law. We also handle all business-related tax returns as well as special statements and analyses. Private tax returns are also part of our service portfolio.

content: Preparation of annual financial statements under commercial and tax law
Preparation of income surplus statements
Preparation of VAT returns
Preparation of trade tax returns
Interim financial statements, provisional credit statements, and liquidation statements
Private tax returns, e.g. income tax and inheritance tax returns
Preparation of corporate income tax returns
Profit determinations

payrollAccounting.title: Payroll Accounting
payrollAccounting.subtitle: Our Services at a Glance

texts.text: We handle your payroll and salary accounting competently, on time, and in full compliance with the law. Outsourcing this sensitive area saves time and costs, reduces administrative effort, and provides security through support from experienced specialists.

texts.title: Simple, Flexible, and Efficient
texts.text: Switching to us is straightforward: you submit all relevant payroll documents once. Thereafter, you only need to inform us of changes such as new hires, departures, salary adjustments, or absences. We take care of everything else. Upon request, we will prepare a non-binding cost comparison between your current internal payroll processing and outsourcing it to our firm. This allows you to quickly identify potential savings and optimization opportunities in your HR management.

texts.title: More Than Payroll
texts.text: In addition to payroll processing, you benefit from our holistic advisory approach. We always keep tax, legal, and business aspects in mind and support you with personnel-related issues beyond payroll.

content: Ongoing payroll and salary accounting
Preparation of all required notifications and certificates
Support with international matters, e.g. employee secondments
Cooperation with specialized attorneys for labor law matters
Payroll cost optimization and advice on tax-efficient structuring options

assetTransfer.title: Asset Transfer / Succession
assetTransfer.subtitle: Our Services in Succession and Asset Planning

texts.text: Thoughtful asset and succession planning creates security – for you, your family, and your business. We act as your independent and trusted advisor, supporting you in evaluating investments and in the long-term, tax-optimized structuring of your assets. Based on your personal income and asset situation, we develop individual strategies that take into account both tax optimization opportunities and your personal objectives. Early planning of asset transfers can lead to significant tax savings and help prevent future conflicts.

texts.title: Reliable Support
texts.text: Loyalty, experience, and professional expertise form the foundation of our advisory services. Together, we develop solutions tailored to your life situation, providing guidance and security for you and the next generation.

texts.title: Legal Notice
texts.text: Financial services are provided in cooperation with a wealth advisory and asset management company belonging to the corporate group and regulated by FINMA. Nexora itself does not provide financial services.

content: Tax-optimized allocation and structuring of assets
Review of wills, inheritance contracts, and gifts with regard to tax implications
Structuring advice for property transfers and gifts
Preparation of inheritance and gift tax returns
Early planning of private and business succession
Development of tax concepts for anticipated succession
Entrepreneurial succession planning from a tax perspective

businessManagement.title: Business and Management Consulting
businessManagement.subtitle: Our Business Consulting Services

texts.text: For your company to remain successful in the long term, clear figures and forward-looking decisions are essential. Increasing competitive pressure, growing complexity, and tighter markets require business planning that identifies opportunities and risks at an early stage. We support you with professional business consulting throughout all phases of your company’s development – from start-up and growth to expansion and succession. We place great value on understandable analyses, realistic planning, and practical recommendations.

texts.title: Planning Security Through Clear Analyses
texts.text: Long-term business and liquidity planning, as well as comparisons of various financing options, create transparency and security. Whether purchase, leasing, loans, factoring, or alternative financing models – we help you select the solution best suited to your business. Cost-benefit analyses and the review of potential funding measures complement our advisory services. We also advise you on minimum turnover and profit requirements, both business and private, as well as on retirement planning and asset accumulation – always tailored to your personal situation.

content: Advice on business development, e.g. start-up and growth phases
Preparation of business development forecasts (profit, capital, and liquidity planning)
Conducting cost-benefit analyses
Preparation of meaningful financial and business analyses
Advice on public funding and support programs
Calculation of minimum business and private turnover and profit requirements
Advice on retirement planning and asset accumulation
Comparison and evaluation of financing alternatives (purchase, leasing, loans, factoring, mezzanine financing, etc.)

legalAdvisory.title: Legal Advisory Support Through Partner Attorneys
legalAdvisory.subtitle: Your Advantages

texts.text: Legal matters are often closely linked to tax and business decisions. To ensure that you are also well advised in legal matters, we work closely with experienced partner attorneys when required. Through our established network, we connect you with the right legal expert and coordinate the interaction between tax and legal advice. This ensures well-founded, practical solutions that integrate legal, tax, and business aspects efficiently and transparently.
Whether contract drafting, corporate law issues, labor law matters, or succession planning – we ensure that you receive competent and reliable legal support when needed.

content: Access to qualified partner attorneys from various legal disciplines
Close coordination between legal and tax advisory services
Clear communication and short decision-making paths
Holistic consideration of your issues

financialServices.title: Financial Services (Regulated)
financialServices.subtitle: Your Benefit

texts.text: In addition to our tax and business consulting services, we provide access to professional financial services. These are offered through a wealth advisory and asset management company belonging to the corporate group and regulated by the Swiss financial supervisory authority. This allows for a holistic view of your financial situation. Tax, business, and asset-related matters can be meaningfully aligned – transparently, in a structured manner, and in compliance with high regulatory standards.
Our goal is to support you reliably in financial matters as well and to develop sustainable, long-term solutions.

content: Access to regulated wealth advisory and asset management services
Holistic alignment of tax, asset, and financial topics
Coordinated advisory services from a single source
Clear structures and high regulatory security
